seed: Somebody has switched the measure features off in Experiments. Every guide on the Redlining shelf teaches one of them, so the shelf is not a shelf any more: it is gone from Help and gone from the Tutorials window, with no dimmed row and no empty submenu left behind. This is the flags-off half of the tutorials work, and until a walk could switch a feature off for its own run it was checked by hand and put back by memory.

steps.note: Help ▸ Tutorials with the measure features off: Basics is still there, Redlining is not, and there is no empty Redlining submenu standing in for it
the Tutorials window says the same thing as the menu: no Redlining shelf, and nothing explaining why
